name: Exam Cram
description: The test is in five days and you haven't started. Here's the plan.

0.title: List every topic; mark the 3 scariest
Notes and past papers into one folder — hunting is today's job, not studying
Set the exam-day alarms now. Two of them.

1.title: Scariest topic #1: study it, make one page of notes
10 practice questions on it — circle every wrong answer

3.title: One past paper, timed. Score it kindly.

4.title: Exam day: re-read your one-pagers only. Nothing new.
You know more than you think. Go.
